LAW REPORTS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
LAW REPORTS
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LXVII OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend, the Law Reports Act, 1875
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary, Part-I, 7th October, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub. dated
7-10-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement: --(1) This Ordinance may be called the Law Reports
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amending of section 6, XVIII of 1875

2. Amending of section 6,
XVIII of 1875.--In the Law Reports Act; 1875 (XVIII of 1875), hereinafter
referred to as the said Act, in section 6, after the word "printed",
the words "in a Law Report" shall be inserted.
